subject: SummitFuels tax ID verification & PO onboarding
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Tim Owens <tim.owens@summitfuels.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SummitFuels tax ID verification & PO onboarding

Hi Tim -

Thanks again for the call this morning. To get SummitFuels fully set up in our procurement system and to issue the first purchase order, accounting needs: 1) a completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if foreign), and 2) one piece of corroborating EIN evidence (IRS letter, bank letter, or signed PDF with EIN).

For clarity, here are the steps we follow:
- You return the W-9/W-8BEN-E to us (PDF)
- We verify the EIN against the provided document and our vendor checks
- Procurement issues a provisional PO that becomes active after tax docs clear

Can you confirm whether SummitFuels will provide a W-9 or a W-8BEN-E? If you prefer, upload both and mark which entity the PO should be issued to. I attached our PO template and a short checklist.

Attaching: redwood_po_template.xlsx (template), onboarding-checklist.pdf (checklist stub)

Appreciate a quick turnaround - Ben in accounting is copied and will confirm payment terms once docs are accepted.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Note: attachment stubs referenced above.

Hi Aisha -

Thanks - attaching a signed W-9 for SummitFuels (US LLC) and a scanned copy of the EIN confirmation letter from our bank. See files: summitfuels_signed_w9.pdf, summitfuels_ein_letter.pdf.

Two quick questions:
1) Is the provisional PO sent to the email on file or will it go through a DocuSign envelope?
2) Our preferred payment terms are net 30; please let me know if accounting needs any additional vendor setup forms (ACH details, remit-to, etc.).

Regards,
Tim Owens
Director of Procurement
SummitFuels LLC

Hi Tim -

Received, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments - I pulled the W-9 and EIN letter into our vendor intake queue. A couple notes:
- We will route a provisional PO to the email on file as a PDF first; if you prefer DocuSign for signature on PO acceptance, we can initiate an envelope. I included a DocuSign link below for the optional PO acceptance flow.
- Ben: can you confirm net-30 is OK from a payments policy perspective and what additional fields we need for ACH setup?

Tim - please confirm the remit-to bank account name exactly as it should appear on our vendor record (Mary or SummitFuels LLC). Once accounting confirms and the EIN check passes, procurement will issue PO RF-2027-078 (provisional).

DocuSign (optional): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456

Thanks,
Aisha

Thanks Aisha / Tim -

Net 30 OK. For ACH we need: bank name, routing transit number, account number, and a voided check or bank letter (we already have the EIN bank letter which helps). Please send the remit-to as: "SummitFuels LLC" to match the W-9.

I'll run the EIN through our verification tool this afternoon; if it resolves, I will mark the vendor record as "Tax Verified" and trigger procurement to finalize PO RF-2027-078. Expect the PO in ~2 business days unless the verification flags.
